description: A revamped fight for the Wither! with parity features from bedrock to original ideas to make the wither fight more challenging.

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Added some setting changes for addons
- Updated config in newer versions to use dialogs instead

> Treat this as a definitive release as I'm marking the Wither as "Complete" and will only focus on fixing bugs from now on

## Changes

- Added 26.1 support.
- Added damage-received compensation for the Wither to better balance against Spears and Maces.
  - Hits from any Spear or Mace now deal reduced damage by default. (Maces can still deal good damage.)
  - 50-damage hits heal the Wither, grant high resistance for 2 seconds, and cause a small explosion.
  - 100-damage hits heal the Wither more, grant stronger resistance for 2 seconds, and cause a massive explosion.
  - 150-damage hits heal the Wither significantly, grant high resistance for 100 seconds, and activate enraged mode.

Enjoy 💖

> This update is only fully out for 1.21.11 and 26.1, you may manually export the other versions but they are not tested thoroughly

## Changes

- Changed the way functions are scheduled so you can leave the fight and come back to it without it breaking. #37 
- Fixed charge area of effect clouds being spawned at a different location because of 2 letters! #21 
- Other fixes and improvements in general.

Thanks for all the support!!!

## Changes

- Nether Star now slowly descends over time. #28 
- Previous 1.21.5-1.21.10 version was an earlier dev build not fully working, fixed #
- Changed the way gamerules are saved and affected and now are reset after 20 minutes to prevent any issues if the pack is disabled and enabled #27 
- Other Bug fixes!


Thanks!!!

# Changes
> 1.21.11 requires changes that need a new version entirely which is ready for release, I'm just waiting for full release.

## DIRECT CHANGES TO THE WITHER
- During the First Phase (300HP-600HP) the Wither will move away from players to maintain its distance and have more effective attacks.
- Skulls shot by the Wither have been buffed further as dangerous (blue) skulls will now have a bigger explosion doing quite a bit more damage than before leaving smoke behind.
- Wither now has less armour during the first phase and increased armour during the second phase.
- Converted Skeletons now carry bows since the mobs they convert from have bows.
- Changes to the amount of Blazes spawned during midpoint
   - <5 Players = 10 Blazes
   - <10 Players = 20 Blazes
   - >10 Players = 30 Blazes

## CHANGES TO ATTACKS
- A swarm of smaller wither skeletons will spawn at 150HP helping the Wither deal with close range attackers.
- The Wither will now regularly shoot a burst of skulls directly at the nearest player, additionally, the skull it shot at the player in earlier versions will now be a slow fire shot marked as dangerous


# Fixes
- Fixed Wither destroying bedrock in very specific cases 
- Reduced volume on enraged skulls they were incredibly loud at 100%

Enjoy! 😎

🐞<- That's a bug!!!

# Changes
- Reworked how the wither is detected, will now work with wither's spawned through: Spawn Egg or /Summon
> Regardless of this change, the Wither can still only be spawned once at a time. If a player tries to summon another while one already exists, it will play a sound, send a message to the nearest player that only one can exist, and return the skulls and soul sand.
- Added very minimal ambient particles (ash) around the Wither.
- Compatibility with 1.21.9 is complete just use 1.21.5+ and it should work fine!

# Fixes
- Fixed destruction toggle not working as intended #24 
- Fixed multiplayer breaking some functions at spawn (hopefully for the last time)


_Keep any bugs and issues coming, please follow the template provided by GitHub!_

sup

# Changes
- Midpoint now throws the player up depending on how close you are to the wither smashing down.
    - Also made the wither only trigger the smash when it is on the ground instead of a time based system.
- Skeletons with Bows will now have a named bow from [Mickey Joe's "Barely Default"](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mickey-joes-relatively-improved-default) 

# Fixes
- Fixed gamerules being overridden whenever fighting the wither #23 
- Fixed some selectors having the wrong format
- Fixed the trail particle at the start of the fight

Thank you for reading and supporting this project! :)

> Mod versions will no longer have the resource pack pre installed you will now need to download it separately on modrinth [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/withers-wrath-rp)

releases.notes:
Welcome Back to another update!

# Changes
- Reworked the enraged mode skulls that got shot out they now shoot up, pause mid air and 1.5s later shoot towards the nearest player per skull as shown below:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/69628d8d-3c03-4d1e-9194-03b7d4d4cc66


## Added
- 20 seconds after the wither is spawned it will now shoot a high speed direct wither skull at a random player.

## Fixed

- Items getting killed by the thunder when the wither is killed is now fixed
- Multiplayer summon should no longer break (I'm surprised no one commented on this it's been in the pack since release 4 years ago)
- Some names were in the wrong format which are now fixed
- Fixed wither dropping armour on death due to incorrect formatting of commands in 1.21.5+
